definition: Required by law or rules; compulsory.
exampleSentence: Safety induction training is mandatory for all site visitors.

definition: Formally forbidden by law or rule.
exampleSentence: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the auditorium.
It is advisable to check the weather forecast before hillwalking.
Photography is permitted in the gallery without flash.

definition: To act in accordance with a wish or command.
exampleSentence: All candidates must comply with examination hall rules.
